name: video-director
description: One master skill (reel-master) for Time Keeper Reels: idea → research → hook and script in the house style → reader panel → voice (one take per act) → pace and transitions → a style from the library (engine looks, 66 code-film styles, Wood Marquetry, AI route) → real credited photos → film → critic → cover, caption and credits. The owner approves the hook, the script, the style and the finished film; nothing paid runs without a yes.
